main_body: Sci-fi building: a large pale blue-grey sloped roof with vents and panel seams, an orange eave band, and a grey front wall with two cyan windows, two dark windows and a central door
top_band: Roof: light blue-grey (#a3b4cb / #8396b2) in rows 1-16 at x=32, with a brighter front-edge line at row 17 (L=201)
evidence: The column at x=32 meets a roof slope with panel seams and vent boxes (rows 1-16). A bright edge line at row 17 and a dark row 18 sit under an orange eave band (rows 19-23). Below that is the front wall (rows 24-43) with windows in dark inset frames and a recessed door with a hazard-striped sill. The roof is a clearly visible top surface and the wall is a distinct front face. The slightly narrowed roof edges read as hip slopes, not receding side faces.

style.evidence: The roof has about 5 steps (#a3b4cb, #8396b2, #667896, #4f5f7a, #3b475e), and the windows carry cyan and navy ramps. Median colours per tile (10) match the stone reference (11), and flat-fill coverage is low (4%). Against that, the candidate has only 29 distinct colours versus 66 and 185 for the references. 76% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, against 7-9% for the references, and the near-black #06070e line along the roof top and bottom gives a sticker-like outline instead of a dark tone of the adjacent material. The wall is mostly mid-grey plates with few texture dots, so it is thinner than the Beodeul pieces.
